children.text:
At King Spa in Virginia, we’ve crafted our spa treatments with lots of love, creating a cozy spot for you and your partner to relax and heal together. Step into a world where you both can share joy and peace with our special services. Each one is made just for the two of you, wrapping you up in comfort and intimate care.

Book your couple’s spa package or visit us on our second-floor kiosk to explore all of our couple’s spa treatments.

children.html:
Heaven for Two

Couples Massage

Our array of massages, including Deep Tissue, Hot Stone, and Swedish, promises to melt away tension and stress. Imagine the bliss of our skilled therapists’ hands working in harmony to ease every ounce of tension from your bodies, leaving you both deeply relaxed and connected. Explore our couples massage options and choose the best one for you and your partner.

children.html:
Glow Together

Couples Facial

Choose from our selection of facials, such as the rejuvenating 24K Gold Facial or the deep-cleansing Basic Facial, designed to refresh and illuminate your skin. These facials are not just about beauty; they’re about spending that quiet, intimate moment together, experiencing rejuvenation side by side.

children.html:
Refresh & Exfoliate

Couple’s Bubble Body Scrub

For couples seeking a unique and deeply cleansing experience, our Couple’s Bubble Body Scrub offers an unmatched opportunity to revitalize your skin. This treatment, combining the traditional Korean body scrub and Turkish bubble bath, exfoliates and purifies, removing dead skin to reveal softer, younger-looking skin beneath. It’s a rejuvenating ritual that also stimulates the lymphatic system, enhancing your natural detox processes as a couple.

children.html:
Vanessa Phillips
★★★★★
I can't recommend this place highly enough. My mom and I live fairly far apart but wanted a chill spa weekend together. It was phenomenal to meet up at Dulles, rent a car, and come to king spa! We really enjoyed the scrubs we got (would call a must experience if it's your first time), outdoor pool, and the environment in general. We were lucky enough to come when they have the spring promotion that if you buy entry + a service, another non-weekend entry is free.
Amanda The Traveler
★★★★★
Amazing Korean Spa with everything you may need! My husband and I went here to get away for a little while and I couldn't be happier with my experience! We were there for 6 hours, visited all of there many Sauna's, steam, ice, and relaxing rooms. And you can not forget there hot and warm pools! And when all is said and done you must visit their restaurant for some eggs, cold noodle soup, and shaved ice with red bean (trust me you'll love it!) As Korean spas go it is a pricier option, but we'll worth it given all of the options, if you're in the area you must try!
Deanna
★★★★★
I went to celebrate my birthday weekend and had a relaxing time. The staff was very helpful and give you a key fob for two separate lockers, one for your shoes and the other for your clothes/personal belongings. The nude pool in the locker rooms isn't my thing but it's available to those who are okay with that. The staff is constantly cleaning, which is a plus 👌🏾; keeps the facility nice and clean. The outdoor pools upstairs were nice and warm/hot. They have several different saunas and the food was good 😊. I didn't get to stay as long as I wanted since I had to leave by a certain time to fight the traffic. I would definitely return.
Megan Durst
★★★★★
I've gone with my small group multiple times and with my spouse and we all thoroughly enjoy it. I usually get the body scrub because who doesn't like their skin feeling like a baby's skin? And the ice bath has become one of my favorite parts, but I've always enjoyed the variety of saunas and bade pool, and the outdoor pool(and hot tub, and bridge) is beautiful & can be relaxing too(Just maybe not on a Saturday when it's busy😅). Definitely going back.
Mykyla J
★★★★★
This place was AMAZING, i stepped out of many comfort zones by going here. Things are a little confusing if you are getting the body scrub service, but there were other people there who helped even if the staff couldn't. Everybody was so friendly. I will continue to keep coming back. It's a 4 hour drive from where i stay, but it is worth the drive. I will also bring other people back along with me spreading the word of this amazing place !!!
Asel Dav
★★★★★
King Spa in Chantilly, VA, is a Korean-inspired spa offering a range of wellness and relaxation services. It features various saunas, including traditional Korean heated rooms, salt rooms, and cold rooms, designed to promote detoxification and relaxation. Additionally, King Spa offers body scrubs, massages, and other therapeutic treatments. The spa also includes amenities such as pools, relaxation lounges, and dining options, making it a comprehensive destination for a rejuvenating experience. This is my favorite place to relax… Highly recommend it, you will love this place ❤️

children.html:
Can treatments be customized for individual needs within a couple's package?
Absolutely! At King Spa Virginia, we understand that each person has unique needs and preferences. Our skilled estheticians and therapists will consult with you to understand your specific desires and skin or body concerns. This way, both of you can enjoy a personalized spa experience that meets your individual needs while still sharing the special moment together.
Are there dining options available on-site?
Yes, we offer a variety of dining options right here at King Spa in Virginia. Our on-site restaurant serves a wide range of delicious meals, including authentic Korean dishes and other cuisines to suit every taste.
Do you offer any amenities or activities that we can enjoy without booking a treatment?
Yes, King Spa Virginia is not just about treatments; we offer a full experience. Even if you’re not booking a specific treatment, you can still enjoy our extensive range of amenities and activities included with your admission pass. Our facility includes unique mineral saunas, hydrotherapy pools, steam rooms, and cold therapy rooms.
Do treatments need to be booked in advance before visiting King Spa?
No, all treatments are booked on a first-come, first-served basis at King Spa. We recommend visiting us on our second-floor kiosk when you arrive to explore all the different couples treatments available and book yours.
